        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import os\n",
        "\n",
        "def save_plot(fig, objective_name, plot_name, google_drive_path='/content/drive/MyDrive'):\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    Saves a matplotlib figure to a structured folder in Google Drive.\n",
        "\n",
        "    Args:\n",
        "        fig (matplotlib.figure.Figure): The figure object to save.\n",
        "        objective_name (str): The name of the objective (e.g., 'Objective 1').\n",
        "        plot_name (str): The specific name for the plot (e.g., 'diagnosis_frequency_bar_chart').\n",
        "        google_drive_path (str): The base path to Google Drive.\n",
        "    \"\"\"\n",
        "    visualization_dir = os.path.join(google_drive_path, 'Visualizations', objective_name.replace(' ', '_'))\n",
        "    os.makedirs(visualization_dir, exist_ok=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "    file_path = os.path.join(visualization_dir, f'{plot_name}.png')\n",
        "    fig.savefig(file_path, bbox_inches='tight')\n",
        "    print(f\"Plot saved to: {file_path}\")"

        "\n",
        "# ------------IDNTIFY AND REMOVE DUPLICATE RECORDS\n",

        "# Makes referencing columns consistent throughout the notebook.\n",
        "# This particular code block is to make sure column names(whe nyou dey defend, call them features instead of column names) are in snake_case and removes any non-alphanumeric characters.\n",
        "original_cols = df.columns.tolist()\n",
        "#-----Remove leading/trailing whitespace\n",
        "df.columns = df.columns.str.strip()\n",
        "#-------------- Convert to lowercase\n",
        "df.columns = df.columns.str.lower()\n",
        "#--------------Replace any non-alphanumeric characters (except underscore) with an underscore\n",
        "df.columns = df.columns.str.replace(r'[^a-z0-9_]', '_', regex=True)\n",
        "#--------------Replace multiple underscores with a single underscore\n",
        "df.columns = df.columns.str.replace(r'__+', '_', regex=True)\n",
        "#------------Remove leading/trailing underscores\n",

        "\n",
        "#-------------CONVERT DATE COLUMNS TO PROPER DATETIME FORMAT\n",
        "date_columns = [\"date_of_admission\", \"discharge_date\"]\n",
        "for col in date_columns:\n",
        "    if col in df.columns:\n",
        "        df[col] = pd.to_datetime(df[col], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nDate column types after conversion:\")\n",
        "print(df[[c for c in date_columns if c in df.columns]].dtypes)\n",
        "\n",
        "#---------VERIFY / CORRECT DATA TYPES FOR KEY CATEGORICAL VARIABLES\n",
        "categorical_cols = [\"gender\", \"blood_type\", \"medical_condition\",\n",
        "                     \"admission_type\", \"test_results\", \"insurance_provider\"]\n",

        "    if col in df.columns:\n",

        "# To determine the most common diagnoses in the hospital patient\n",
        "#            dataset.\n",
        "\n",
        "#----------------FREQUENCY COUNT OF DIAGNOSES (MEDICAL CONDITIONS)\n",
        "diagnosis_col = \"medical_condition\"\n",
        "diagnosis_counts = df[diagnosis_col].value_counts()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Frequency of each diagnosis:\\n\", diagnosis_counts)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "# ------------CONVERT TO PERCENTAGES FOR EASIER INTERPRETATION\n",
        "diagnosis_percent = df[diagnosis_col].value_counts(normalize=True) * 100\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nPercentage share of each diagnosis:\\n\", diagnosis_percent.round(2))\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "#-----------SUMMARY TABLE (Counts + Percentages Combined)\n",
        "\n",
        "diagnosis_summary = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Frequency\": diagnosis_counts,\n",
        "    \"Percentage (%)\": diagnosis_percent.round(2)\n",
        "}).sort_values(by=\"Frequency\", ascending=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nDiagnosis Summary Table:\")\n",
        "display(diagnosis_summary)\n",
        "\n",
        "#-----------------VISUALISATION - BAR CHART OF DIAGNOSIS FREQUENCY\n",

        "# =============================================================================\n",
        "# BLOCK 3: OBJECTIVE 3 - DISTRIBUTION OF TEST RESULTS AMONG ADMITTED PATIENTS\n",
        "# =============================================================================\n",
        "# Objective: To analyse the distribution of test results among admitted\n",
        "#            patients.\n",
        "# Research Question: What is the distribution of test results (e.g. Normal,\n",
        "#                     Abnormal, Inconclusive) among admitted patients?\n",
        "# Method   : Frequency count + percentage breakdown + bar/pie chart\n",
        "#            visualisation (Section 3.12).\n",
        "# =============================================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "# NOTE: Update this if your cleaned column name differs.\n",
        "test_result_col = \"test_results\"\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 1. FREQUENCY COUNT OF TEST RESULTS\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "test_result_counts = df[test_result_col].value_counts()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Frequency of each test result:\\n\")\n",
        "print(test_result_counts)\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 2. PERCENTAGE BREAKDOWN OF TEST RESULTS\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "test_result_percent = df[test_result_col].value_counts(normalize=True) * 100\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nPercentage share of each test result:\\n\")\n",
        "print(test_result_percent.round(2))\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 3. SUMMARY TABLE (Counts + Percentages Combined)\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "test_result_summary = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Frequency\": test_result_counts,\n",
        "    \"Percentage (%)\": test_result_percent.round(2)\n",
        "}).sort_values(by=\"Frequency\", ascending=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nTest Result Summary Table:\")\n",
        "display(test_result_summary)\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",

      "source": [
        "# =============================================================================\n",
        "# BLOCK 4: OBJECTIVE 4 - SEASONAL TRENDS IN DISEASE OCCURRENCE\n",
        "# =============================================================================\n",
        "# Objective: To examine seasonal trends in disease occurrence based on\n",
        "#            admission dates.\n",
        "# Research Question: Are there seasonal patterns in disease occurrence based\n",
        "#                     on the month/season of hospital admission?\n",
        "# Method   : Extract month/season from admission date, aggregate diagnosis\n",
        "#            counts over time, line/heatmap visualisation (Section 3.12).\n",
        "# =============================================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "# NOTE: Update these if your cleaned column names differ.\n",
        "diagnosis_col = \"medical_condition\"\n",
        "admission_date_col = \"date_of_admission\"\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 1. EXTRACT MONTH AND SEASON FROM ADMISSION DATE\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# Ensure the admission date column is in datetime format (done in Block 0,\n",
        "# re-checked here for safety in case this block is run independently).\n",
        "df[admission_date_col] = pd.to_datetime(df[admission_date_col], errors=\"coerce\")\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"admission_month\"] = df[admission_date_col].dt.month\n",
        "df[\"admission_month_name\"] = df[admission_date_col].dt.month_name()\n",
        "\n",
        "def month_to_season(month):\n",
        "    \"\"\"Maps a calendar month (1-12) to a meteorological season.\"\"\"\n",
        "    if month in [12, 1, 2]:\n",
        "        return \"Winter\"\n",
        "    elif month in [3, 4, 5]:\n",
        "        return \"Spring\"\n",
        "    elif month in [6, 7, 8]:\n",
        "        return \"Summer\"\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        return \"Autumn\"\n",
        "\n",
        "df[\"admission_season\"] = df[\"admission_month\"].apply(month_to_season)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Sample of extracted month/season fields:\")\n",
        "display(df[[admission_date_col, \"admission_month_name\", \"admission_season\"]].head())\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 2. MONTHLY ADMISSION COUNTS (OVERALL TREND)\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "month_order = [\"January\", \"February\", \"March\", \"April\", \"May\", \"June\",\n",
        "                \"July\", \"August\", \"September\", \"October\", \"November\", \"December\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "monthly_counts = (\n",
        "    df[\"admission_month_name\"]\n",
        "    .value_counts()\n",
        "    .reindex(month_order)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nOverall admissions per month:\\n\")\n",
        "print(monthly_counts)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(11, 6))\n",
        "sns.lineplot(x=monthly_counts.index, y=monthly_counts.values, marker=\"o\", color=\"darkorange\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Overall Hospital Admissions by Month\", fontsize=14, weight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Month\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Number of Admissions\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45)\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 3. SEASONAL ADMISSION COUNTS (OVERALL TREND)\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "season_order = [\"Winter\", \"Spring\", \"Summer\", \"Autumn\"]\n",
        "seasonal_counts = df[\"admission_season\"].value_counts().reindex(season_order)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nOverall admissions per season:\\n\")\n",
        "print(seasonal_counts)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
        "sns.barplot(\n",
        "    x=seasonal_counts.index,\n",
        "    y=seasonal_counts.values,\n",
        "    hue=seasonal_counts.index,\n",
        "    palette=\"crest\",\n",
        "    legend=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Overall Hospital Admissions by Season\", fontsize=14, weight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Season\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Number of Admissions\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 4. DIAGNOSIS TRENDS ACROSS MONTHS (HEATMAP)\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# Cross-tabulate diagnosis against month to reveal seasonal disease patterns.\n",
        "diagnosis_month_table = pd.crosstab(df[diagnosis_col], df[\"admission_month_name\"])\n",
        "diagnosis_month_table = diagnosis_month_table.reindex(columns=month_order)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(13, 7))\n",
        "sns.heatmap(diagnosis_month_table, cmap=\"YlOrRd\", annot=True, fmt=\"d\", linewidths=0.5)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Diagnosis Frequency by Month (Seasonal Pattern)\", fontsize=14, weight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Month\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Diagnosis / Medical Condition\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 5. DIAGNOSIS TRENDS ACROSS SEASONS\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "diagnosis_season_table = pd.crosstab(df[diagnosis_col], df[\"admission_season\"])\n",
        "diagnosis_season_table = diagnosis_season_table.reindex(columns=season_order)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nDiagnosis counts by season:\")\n",
        "display(diagnosis_season_table)\n",
        "\n",
        "diagnosis_season_table.plot(kind=\"bar\", figsize=(12, 7), colormap=\"crest\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Diagnosis Frequency by Season\", fontsize=14, weight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Diagnosis / Medical Condition\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Number of Patients\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha=\"right\")\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Season\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 6. INTERPRETATION HELPER - PEAK MONTH AND SEASON\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "peak_month = monthly_counts.idxmax()\n",
        "peak_season = seasonal_counts.idxmax()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\nThe month with the highest number of admissions is '{peak_month}' \"\n",
        "      f\"({monthly_counts.max()} admissions).\")\n",
        "print(f\"The season with the highest number of admissions is '{peak_season}' \"\n",
        "      f\"({seasonal_counts.max()} admissions).\")"

      "source": [
        "# =============================================================================\n",
        "# BLOCK 5: OBJECTIVE 5 - GENDER VS DIAGNOSIS FREQUENCY RELATIONSHIP\n",
        "# =============================================================================\n",
        "# Objective: To assess the relationship between patient gender and diagnosis\n",
        "#            frequency.\n",
        "# Research Question: Is there a relationship between patient gender and the\n",
        "#                     frequency of specific diagnoses?\n",
        "# Method   : Cross-tabulation (contingency table) + grouped bar chart +\n",
        "#            heatmap visualisation (Section 3.12).\n",
        "# =============================================================================\n",
        "\n",
        "# NOTE: Update these if your cleaned column names differ.\n",
        "diagnosis_col = \"medical_condition\"\n",
        "gender_col = \"gender\"\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 1. OVERALL GENDER DISTRIBUTION IN THE DATASET\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "gender_counts = df[gender_col].value_counts()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Overall gender distribution:\\n\")\n",
        "print(gender_counts)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6, 6))\n",
        "plt.pie(\n",
        "    gender_counts.values,\n",
        "    labels=gender_counts.index,\n",
        "    autopct=\"%1.1f%%\",\n",
        "    startangle=90,\n",
        "    colors=sns.color_palette(\"Set2\", len(gender_counts))\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Overall Gender Distribution\", fontsize=14, weight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 2. CROSS-TABULATION - DIAGNOSIS COUNTS BY GENDER\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "gender_diagnosis_table = pd.crosstab(df[diagnosis_col], df[gender_col])\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nDiagnosis counts by gender:\\n\")\n",
        "display(gender_diagnosis_table)\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 3. CROSS-TABULATION - PERCENTAGE WITHIN EACH DIAGNOSIS\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# Shows, for each diagnosis, what proportion is male vs female.\n",
        "gender_diagnosis_pct = pd.crosstab(\n",
        "    df[diagnosis_col], df[gender_col], normalize=\"index\"\n",
        ") * 100\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nGender share (%) within each diagnosis:\\n\")\n",
        "display(gender_diagnosis_pct.round(2))\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 4. VISUALISATION - GROUPED BAR CHART OF DIAGNOSIS BY GENDER\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "gender_diagnosis_table.plot(kind=\"bar\", figsize=(12, 7), colormap=\"Set2\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Diagnosis Frequency by Gender\", fontsize=14, weight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Diagnosis / Medical Condition\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Number of Patients\")\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha=\"right\")\n",
        "plt.legend(title=\"Gender\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 5. VISUALISATION - HEATMAP OF DIAGNOSIS VS GENDER\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 9))\n",
        "sns.heatmap(gender_diagnosis_table, annot=True, fmt=\"d\", cmap=\"PuBuGn\", linewidths=0.5)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Diagnosis vs Gender Heatmap\", fontsize=14, weight=\"bold\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Gender\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Diagnosis / Medical Condition\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 6. STATISTICAL ASSOCIATION - CHI-SQUARE TEST OF INDEPENDENCE\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# Tests whether gender and diagnosis are statistically associated.\n",
        "# NOTE: This is an optional descriptive-EDA add-on, not the core study design\n",
        "# (Chapter 3 specifies a descriptive design). Included for extra rigor if your\n",
        "# supervisor wants a formal association check; safe to remove if not needed.\n",
        "from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency\n",
        "\n",
        "chi2, p_value, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(gender_diagnosis_table)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\nChi-square test of independence (Gender vs Diagnosis):\")\n",
        "print(f\"Chi-square statistic = {chi2:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Degrees of freedom   = {dof}\")\n",
        "print(f\"p-value              = {p_value:.4f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "if p_value < 0.05:\n",
        "    print(\"Result: Statistically significant association between gender and \"\n",
        "          \"diagnosis (p < 0.05).\")\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    print(\"Result: No statistically significant association between gender and \"\n",
        "          \"diagnosis (p >= 0.05).\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "# 7. INTERPRETATION HELPER - DIAGNOSIS WITH STRONGEST GENDER SKEW\n",
        "# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
        "gender_diagnosis_pct[\"skew\"] = (gender_diagnosis_pct.max(axis=1))\n",
        "most_skewed_diagnosis = gender_diagnosis_pct[\"skew\"].idxmax()\n",
        "skew_value = gender_diagnosis_pct[\"skew\"].max()\n",

        "      f\"'{most_skewed_diagnosis}' at {skew_value:.2f}% concentrated in one gender.\")"
